### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows "page not found" (404) instead of loading the widgets page.

### Why it is broken

The part of the code that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly and does not remove a final slash, so `/widgets/` does not match the widgets page. A local test reproduced the failure, and a follow-up check confirmed this cause.

### How to fix it

Remove the final slash from the address before the comparison, so `/widgets/` and `/widgets` both open the widgets page. An existing ticket already covers this problem, so no new ticket was created and the tracker was not changed. Follow-up continues on that ticket ([ticket](https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42)).
